transports.description: Slack MCP server (stdio, Go binary, version-pinned). Requires at least one token env var (SLACK_MCP_XOXB_TOKEN recommended). send_message tool disabled by default — set SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL=1 to enable.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List public channels in the Slack workspace.

tools.name: get_channel_history
tools.description: Retrieve message history from a Slack channel.

tools.name: get_thread_replies
tools.description: Get all replies in a Slack message thread.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search Slack messages across the workspace by keyword.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the Slack workspace.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get profile details for a specific Slack user.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or thread. Opt-in: requires SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL=1. Gates through TLA confirmation before sending. Link unfurling disabled by default (set SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_UNFURLING=1 to enable).

configurableProperties.label: Slack Bot Token (xoxb-)
configurableProperties.description: Slack bot OAuth token (xoxb-...). Recommended auth method. Generated from your Slack app's OAuth & Permissions page. At least one of SLACK_MCP_XOXB_TOKEN, SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN, or SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN + SLACK_MCP_XOXD_TOKEN must be set.

configurableProperties.label: Slack User OAuth Token (xoxp-)
configurableProperties.description: Slack user OAuth token (xoxp-...). Alternative to bot token. Has user-level permissions.

configurableProperties.label: Slack Browser Session Token (xoxc-)
configurableProperties.description: Slack browser session cookie token (xoxc-...). Stealth mode — used together with SLACK_MCP_XOXD_TOKEN.

configurableProperties.label: Slack Browser Session d= Cookie (xoxd-)
configurableProperties.description: Slack d= session cookie value (xoxd-...). Used together with SLACK_MCP_XOXC_TOKEN for stealth mode.

configurableProperties.label: Enable send_message Tool
configurableProperties.description: Set to any non-empty value (e.g. '1') to enable the send_message tool. Disabled by default — message sending requires explicit opt-in.

configurableProperties.label: Enable Link Unfurling in send_message
configurableProperties.description: Set to any non-empty value (e.g. '1') to enable Slack link unfurling in sent messages. Disabled by default. Warning: link unfurling causes Slack to fetch URLs in sent messages — enables exfiltration of attacker-controlled URLs if an LLM sends a prompt-injected message.

trust.notes: Community Slack MCP server v1.3.0 — Go binary (not Node.js). Supports three auth modes: bot token (xoxb-), user OAuth (xoxp-), or stealth browser session tokens (xoxc-/xoxd-). Read-only tools (list_channels, get_channel_history, search_messages, etc.) are enabled by default. send_message is disabled by default and requires explicit env opt-in. Link unfurling in send_message is disabled by default — a critical defense against the lethal-trifecta exfiltration attack (LLM reads injected Slack content → crafts URL in send_message → Slack unfurls to attacker server).
trust.securityNotes: Source pinned to SHA a079b3cd4d5836d791c942a9fc107987e7865b37 (v1.3.0) via Go module proxy + sumdb verification. SLACK_MCP_XOXB_TOKEN stored as dmcp secret. Bot token scope to minimum Slack OAuth scopes: channels:read, channels:history, users:read (add chat:write only if send_message is enabled). send_message triggers real outbound messages — TLA gate mandatory, enable only via SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL. Do NOT enable SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_UNFURLING: link unfurling + send_message + untrusted channel content creates a prompt-injection exfiltration path (attacker posts malicious Slack message → LLM reads it → LLM sends message with attacker URL → Slack fetches URL to unfurl → exfiltration). Prompt injection risk: Slack channel content (messages, user names, channel topics) may contain injected instructions — treat all Slack data as untrusted input.
